نندمج (form VII)
# نَنْدَمِجُ (nandamiju) /nan.da.mi.d͡ʒu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْدَمَجَ (indamaja)
# نَنْدَمِجَ (nandamija) /nan.da.mi.d͡ʒa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْدَمَجَ (indamaja)
# نَنْدَمِجْ (nandamij) /nan.da.mid͡ʒ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْدَمَجَ (indamaja)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
